_note: Posture finding shape mirrors Prowler OCSF-style output. Each entry is one check result.
check_title: Ensure hardware MFA is enabled for the root account
remediation: Enable a hardware MFA device on the root account. Console: IAM → Security Credentials.

check_title: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
remediation: Update the trail to capture events from all regions: aws cloudtrail update-trail --name prod-org-trail --is-multi-region-trail

check_title: Ensure S3 buckets do not allow public read access
remediation: Remove the public read statement from the bucket policy; enable S3 Block Public Access at account level.

check_title: IAM access keys should be rotated every 90 days
Ensure GuardDuty is enabled in all active regions
